title: Bug: median() picks the wrong element for even-length input and percentile() extrapolates beyond the data
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/statistics_utils.py`

`median()` returns the lower of the two middle elements for even-length lists instead of their mean. `percentile(data, p)` for p=0 goes out of bounds.
### Expected
- median([1,2,3,4]) == 2.5
- `percentile(data, 0)` returns min, `percentile(data, 100)` returns max
